mainTopic: Unborn calves with different holiness, and the משנה's rule that a status that came through something else passes on only 'by calculation'
overview: The amud opens by finishing two questions אביי asked רב יוסף about a pregnant animal whose mother and unborn calf have different holiness. If the mother is שלמים and the calf is חולין, slaughtering her in the עזרה is not חולין בעזרה, because that פסוק only covers animals that could have been slaughtered outside. If the mother is חולין and the calf is שלמים, slaughtering her outside is not שחוטי חוץ, because that prohibition only covers animals fit to be brought to the אהל מועד, and an unborn calf is not. Then a new משנה lists cases where a status that came through something else cannot pass on in full. These are a mixture of תרומה, leavened dough, drawn water in a מקוה, מי חטאת, a בית הפרס, a second תרומה, and a תמורה. רבי יהודה and the חכמים argue whether the offspring of a holy animal can make a תמורה. The גמרא then asks whose view each rule follows. רבי יוחנן says the mixture and dough rules do not follow רבי אליעזר, and proves it from משניות where the חכמים count only the real share of the forbidden item. For the drawn-water rule he names רבי אליעזר בן יעקב, and the גמרא begins quoting his case of a מקוה with 21 סאה of rainwater. That case continues on the next amud.

steps.title: An unborn non-sacred calf inside a sacred mother is not counted as חולין בעזרה
steps.stepSummary: רב יוסף answers אביי's earlier question. Slaughtering a pregnant שלמים in the עזרה does not violate חולין בעזרה, even though the unborn calf inside her is חולין.
steps.simpleTranslation: He said to him: Do we apply to this case the verse 'If the place is too far from you... then you shall slaughter'?
steps.whatsHappening: רב יוסף answers the question asked just before this text. The person did not sin with the חולין calf, because the פסוק forbidding חולין בעזרה does not fit this case.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The prohibition of slaughtering חולין in the עזרה comes from a פסוק that says to slaughter ordinary meat 'far from the place,' meaning outside. That only applies to an animal that could have been slaughtered outside. Here the mother is a שלמים and must be slaughtered in the עזרה, so the calf inside her had no other option.

keyTerms.meaning: Do we read [this verse] about it? This is a rhetorical way of saying the verse does not apply here.
Non-sacred animals slaughtered in the Temple courtyard, which is forbidden.
'If the place is too far from you.' This is the source for slaughtering ordinary meat away from the Temple.

steps.confusionAlert: The question is not asked as a real question. 'Do we read this verse about it?' means 'Obviously the verse does not apply here,' so the answer is that he is not liable.

phrases.english: He said to him:
phrases.notes: This is רב יוסף answering אביי's question about a שלמים mother carrying a חולין calf, slaughtered in the עזרה.

phrases.english: Do we read regarding it
"If the place be too far from you...
then you shall slaughter"?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers אביי's question from just before this text.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Whether slaughtering a pregnant שלמים in the עזרה violates חולין בעזרה because of the חולין calf inside her.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: No. The פסוק only covers animals that could have been slaughtered outside, and this calf could not be.

steps.title: The reverse case: a non-sacred mother carrying a sacred calf, slaughtered outside
steps.stepSummary: אביי asks the opposite question. If the mother is חולין and the unborn calf is שלמים, and she is slaughtered outside the עזרה, does he violate שחוטי חוץ?
steps.simpleTranslation: אביי asked רב יוסף: If the mother is non-sacred and her unborn offspring is a peace offering, and he slaughtered her outside, what is the law? Is he liable for slaughtering a sacrifice outside, or not?
steps.whatsHappening: אביי flips the earlier case around and asks a new question. Now the holy animal is the calf inside, and the slaughter took place outside the עזרה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Slaughtering a קרבן outside the עזרה is a serious sin called שחוטי חוץ. When you slaughter the mother, you are also in a sense slaughtering the calf inside her. Since that calf is a שלמים, אביי asks whether this counts as slaughtering a קרבן outside.

keyTerms.meaning: Slaughtering a sacrifice outside the Temple courtyard, which is forbidden.
Peace offerings, a type of sacrifice.
Her offspring, here meaning the unborn calf inside her.
What is [the law]? This is the standard way of asking a question.

phrases.english: Abaye asked of Rav Yosef:
She is non-sacred, and her offspring is a peace offering,
and he slaughtered her outside — what is the law?
Is he liable for it
because of slaughtering outside, or not?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Mirrors the earlier case: now the holy animal is the calf, and the slaughter is outside instead of inside.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Whether slaughtering a חולין mother outside makes him liable for שחוטי חוץ because of the שלמים calf inside her.

steps.title: No שחוטי חוץ, because the unborn calf cannot be brought to the משכן
steps.stepSummary: רב יוסף answers that he is not liable. The פסוק of שחוטי חוץ talks about animals that can be 'brought to ה׳', and an unborn calf cannot be.
steps.simpleTranslation: He said to him: Do we apply to this case the verse 'that they may bring them to the Lord'?
steps.whatsHappening: רב יוסף answers אביי that there is no liability for שחוטי חוץ. He uses the same style of answer as before.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The פסוק of שחוטי חוץ speaks about people who should have brought their sacrifices to ה׳ instead. That only fits an animal that could actually be brought and offered. An unborn calf cannot be offered until it is born, so killing it outside is not שחוטי חוץ.

keyTerms.meaning: 'That they may bring them to ה׳.' This is the פסוק behind the prohibition of שחוטי חוץ.

steps.whatToRemember: Both answers follow the same idea. Each prohibition only applies when its פסוק actually fits the case. חולין בעזרה needs an animal that could have been slaughtered outside. שחוטי חוץ needs an animal that could have been brought inside.

phrases.english: He said to him:
Do we read regarding it
"That they may bring them to the Lord"?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers אביי's reverse question, using the same type of answer as step 1.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: Not liable. The prohibition only covers animals that can be brought to ה׳, and an unborn calf cannot be.

steps.title: Another version: liability only for an animal fit for the entrance of the אהל מועד
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא gives another version of רב יוסף's answer. One is liable outside only for an animal fit to come to the entrance of the אהל מועד, and an unborn calf is not fit.
steps.simpleTranslation: Another version: He said to him: Something that is fit for the entrance of the אהל מועד, one is liable for it outside.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a second way that רב יוסף's answer was reported. It reaches the same result, that he is not liable.
steps.deeperAnalysis: This version uses the words 'to the entrance of the אהל מועד' from the same section of פסוקים. It states the rule positively: liability for שחוטי חוץ is only for an animal fit to be offered inside. The unborn calf is not fit, so there is no liability.

keyTerms.meaning: Another version of how the statement was said.
Fit to be brought to the entrance of the אהל מועד, meaning fit to be offered.
Outside the Temple courtyard.

steps.whatToRemember: Both versions agree on the halacha: no שחוטי חוץ for an unborn holy calf. They differ only in which words of the פסוק they quote.

phrases.english: Another version: he said to him:
Something fit for the entrance of the Tent of Meeting
phrases.notes: This comes from ויקרא 17:4, 'and has not brought it to the entrance of the אהל מועד.'

phrases.english: one is liable for it outside.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives a second version of the answer in step 3, with the same result.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: Liability outside applies only to an animal fit for the entrance of the אהל מועד, and an unborn calf is not fit.

steps.title: Mixtures, leavening, and drawn water work only by calculation
steps.stepSummary: The משנה opens by teaching three cases. In each, something that got its status from a mixture can only pass it on according to how much of the original stuff is really inside it.
steps.simpleTranslation: משנה: A mixture of תרומה does not make another mixture into a mixture of תרומה, except by calculation. Dough leavened by תרומה does not make other dough forbidden, except by calculation. Drawn water does not ruin a מקוה, except by calculation.
steps.whatsHappening: A new משנה begins. It teaches that something already mixed cannot pass on its status at full strength. We only count the real amount of the original forbidden item inside it.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Take a mixture that is forbidden because it contains תרומה. If it falls into more regular food, we do not treat the whole first mixture as if it were pure תרומה. We only count the actual תרומה inside it. The same idea works for leavening and for drawn water in a מקוה.

keyTerms.meaning: A mixture of תרומה with regular food that is forbidden to non-כהנים
Dough leavened with a leavening agent of תרומה
Drawn water (water carried in a container), which can make a מקוה unfit
By calculation: counting only the real amount of the original item
A ritual bath used for becoming טהור

steps.confusionAlert: 'By calculation' does not mean the mixture has no effect at all. It means we count only the amount of real תרומה (or real leavening, or real drawn water) inside it, not the whole mixture.

phrases.english: MISHNAH:
A mixture of תרומה does not make another mixture of תרומה,
except according to calculation.
And dough leavened with תרומה does not leaven other dough
except according to calculation,
and drawn water does not
make the מקוה unfit
except according to calculation.

steps.triggerLanguage: מַתְנִי׳ אֵין הַמְדוּמָּע מְדַמֵּעַ, אֶלָּא לְפִי חֶשְׁבּוֹן
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Starts a new משנה after the גמרא's discussion of the unborn calf.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: A mixed item passes on its status only according to the real amount of the original item inside it.

steps.title: Water of purification, a plowed grave field, and a second תרומה
steps.stepSummary: The משנה adds three more cases where a status cannot be passed on or repeated. מי חטאת is made only by putting ashes in. A בית הפרס does not create another בית הפרס. A second separation of תרומה does not work.
steps.simpleTranslation: מי חטאת does not make other water into מי חטאת; only putting in the ashes does. A בית הפרס does not create another בית הפרס. And there is no תרומה after תרומה.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה continues its list with three more examples of the same idea.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Water only becomes מי חטאת when the ashes of the פרה אדומה are actually put into it. A field that became a בית הפרס because a grave was plowed in it does not spread that status to the next field. Once a person has separated תרומה, a second separation from the same produce does not become תרומה.

keyTerms.meaning: Water of purification, made with the ashes of the red heifer
Placing the ashes into the water
A field where a grave was plowed, which the חכמים declared טמא
The portion of produce set aside for the כהן

phrases.aramaic: וְאֵין מֵי חַטָּאת, עוֹשִׂין מֵי חַטָּאת
phrases.english: And water of purification does not make other water into water of purification
except with the placing of the ashes,
phrases.notes: Only putting the red heifer's ashes into the water makes it מי חטאת.

phrases.aramaic: וְאֵין בֵּית הַפְּרָס עוֹשִׂין בֵּית הַפְּרָס,
phrases.english: and a בית הפרס does not make another בית הפרס,
and there is no תרומה after תרומה.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְאֵין מֵי חַטָּאת, עוֹשִׂין מֵי חַטָּאת אֶלָּא עִם מַתַּן אֵפֶר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the משנה's list of cases.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: מי חטאת is made only by placing the ashes; a בית הפרס does not create another; a second separation of תרומה is not תרומה.

steps.title: A substitute and an offspring cannot make a new substitute
steps.stepSummary: The משנה reaches the topic of this מסכת. An animal that became holy as a תמורה cannot itself make another תמורה. The offspring of a קדשים animal also cannot make a תמורה.
steps.simpleTranslation: A תמורה does not make a new תמורה. And the offspring does not make a תמורה.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה applies the same idea to תמורה. It gives the opening ruling, which is the view of the תנא קמא.
steps.deeperAnalysis: An animal that became holy only because it was swapped for a קדשים animal cannot be swapped again to make a new holy animal. In the same way, the תנא קמא holds that a calf born from a holy animal cannot make a תמורה. Its holiness came only through its mother.

keyTerms.meaning: A regular animal that becomes holy when someone tries to swap it for a holy animal
The offspring born from a holy animal
Has the power to make a swapped animal into a תמורה

steps.whyThisMatters: Here the משנה reaches the subject of this מסכת. The ruling about the offspring is what רבי יהודה and the חכמים argue about in the next two steps.

phrases.english: And a substitute does not make a substitute,
nor does the offspring make a substitute.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְאֵין תְּמוּרָה עוֹשָׂה תְּמוּרָה, וְלֹא הַוָּלָד עוֹשֶׂה תְּמוּרָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Applies the list's idea to תמורה, the topic of the מסכת.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Neither a תמורה nor the offspring of a holy animal can make a new תמורה.

steps.title: רבי יהודה says the offspring can make a substitute
steps.stepSummary: רבי יהודה disagrees about the offspring. He holds that it can make a תמורה.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי יהודה says: The offspring makes a תמורה.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי יהודה argues on the second half of the opening ruling. He disagrees only about the offspring.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי יהודה does not argue that a תמורה can make a תמורה. His argument is only about the offspring. He treats the calf like a regular holy animal, which can make a תמורה.

phrases.english: רבי יהודה says:
The offspring makes a substitute.

steps.triggerLanguage: רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר: הַוָּלָד עוֹשֶׂה תְּמוּרָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Disagrees with the second half of step 7.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: According to רבי יהודה, the offspring of a holy animal can make a תמורה.

steps.title: The חכמים answer that only a holy animal itself makes a substitute
steps.stepSummary: The חכמים answer רבי יהודה. A הקדש animal makes a תמורה, but the offspring does not.
steps.simpleTranslation: They said to him: A consecrated animal makes a תמורה, but the offspring does not make a תמורה.
steps.whatsHappening: The חכמים push back on רבי יהודה. They draw a line between the holy animal itself and its offspring.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The חכמים agree that a holy animal makes a תמורה. But they say the offspring is not in that same group. This fits the whole משנה: something that got its status only through something else cannot pass that status on in the full way.

keyTerms.meaning: Something consecrated, here the holy animal itself

steps.whatToRemember: The whole משנה teaches one idea: a status that came through something else is secondary, and it cannot pass on in the full way. Examples are a mixture, a בית הפרס, a תמורה, and the offspring.

phrases.english: They said to him:
phrases.notes: 'They' are the חכמים, answering רבי יהודה.

phrases.english: A consecrated animal makes a substitute,
but the offspring does not make a substitute.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמְרוּ לוֹ: הֶקְדֵּשׁ עוֹשֶׂה תְּמוּרָה, וְאֵין הַוָּלָד עוֹשֶׂה תְּמוּרָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers רבי יהודה's view from step 8.
steps.dechiyaRejectionScope: Rejects רבי יהודה's claim that the offspring makes a תמורה.
steps.dechiyaFlawIdentified: רבי יהודה treats the offspring like the holy animal itself. But only the animal that was itself הקדש makes a תמורה.

steps.title: Who is the author of the first rule in the משנה?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא opens by asking which תנא taught the משנה's rule that a mixture passes on its status only according to the calculation.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא starts and asks a simple question: whose opinion is the משנה following? This sets up the answer in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Step 5 taught that something which got its status from a mixture passes it on only according to how much real original stuff is inside. The גמרא wants to know who holds this, which implies some תנא disagrees.

keyTerms.meaning: The discussion that explains and analyzes the משנה
'Who is the תנא?' A question asking whose opinion a teaching follows

phrases.english: GEMARA: Who is the tanna?
phrases.notes: He is asking about the משנה's first case: a mixture passes on its status only by the real amount of תרומה inside.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Turns from the משנה (steps 5-9) to the גמרא's analysis of its first rule.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Which תנא's view the 'according to the calculation' rule reflects.

steps.title: רבי יוחנן: not רבי אליעזר
steps.stepSummary: רבי חייא בר אבא, quoting רבי יוחנן, answers that the משנה does not follow רבי אליעזר.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי חייא בר אבא said in the name of רבי יוחנן: it is not like רבי אליעזר.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the question by saying who the משנה does NOT follow: רבי אליעזר. The proof comes in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Instead of naming the author, רבי יוחנן rules out one opinion. This tells us רבי אליעזר holds differently about mixtures, so the משנה must follow his opponents.

keyTerms.meaning: 'Not in accordance with.' The teaching does not follow this sage's view

phrases.english: Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba said
Rabbi Yochanan said:
It is not in accordance with Rabbi Eliezer.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר רַבִּי חִיָּיא בַּר אַבָּא אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן דְּלָא כְּרַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The משנה does not follow רבי אליעזר.

steps.title: רבי אליעזר treats a סאה from a mixture like pure תרומה
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא brings a משנה in which רבי אליעזר says that a סאה falling from a mixture makes the next pile forbidden as if it were real תרומה.
steps.simpleTranslation: As we learned: A סאה of תרומה fell into less than a hundred סאה of חולין, so the whole pile became a forbidden mixture (מדומע). Then a סאה from that mixture fell somewhere else. רבי אליעזר says: it makes the new pile forbidden as if it were definite תרומה. (For I say: maybe the very סאה that fell in is the one that came out.)
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא proves step 11 by quoting a משנה where רבי אליעזר holds the opposite of our משנה. He does not count by calculation. He treats the fallen סאה as full תרומה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Our משנה says a mixture passes on its status only by its real share of תרומה. רבי אליעזר says the סאה from the mixture counts as full תרומה, because maybe it is exactly the original סאה of תרומה. So our משנה cannot be his view.

keyTerms.meaning: A measure of volume
The portion of produce given to a כהן; forbidden to non-כהנים
Ordinary, non-holy produce
A forbidden mixture of תרומה and חולין that was not cancelled out
Definite, real תרומה
'That came up/out.' The same סאה that went in is the one that was taken out

steps.confusionAlert: רבי אליעזר does not say the second סאה is surely pure תרומה. He says it might be, so we must treat it strictly, as if it were. That is why he refuses to count by calculation.

phrases.english: As we learned: A se'a of terumah
phrases.notes: This is a משנה in תרומות 5:6.

phrases.english: that fell into less than one hundred se'a of non-sacred produce,
phrases.notes: With less than a hundred, the תרומה is too much to be cancelled out.

phrases.english: and they became a forbidden mixture,
and some of the mixture fell into another place,
Rabbi Eliezer says:
it makes a forbidden mixture like definite terumah
(for I say:
phrases.notes: Some versions leave out the words in round brackets here.

phrases.english: the se'a that fell in is the one that came out).

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Brings the source behind רבי יוחנן's claim in step 11.
steps.raayaObject: That רבי אליעזר disagrees with the 'according to the calculation' rule.
steps.raayaSupportSource: משנה in תרומות 5:6, רבי אליעזר's ruling about a סאה from a mixture.

steps.title: The חכמים count only the real share of תרומה
steps.stepSummary: The חכמים say the סאה from the mixture forbids the new pile only according to how much real תרומה is in it, which matches our משנה.
steps.simpleTranslation: And the חכמים say: it makes the new pile forbidden only according to the amount of תרומה inside it.
steps.whatsHappening: The second half of the same משנה shows the opposing view, the חכמים. Their wording matches our משנה, so our משנה follows them.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The חכמים assume the תרומה spread evenly through the first mixture. So a סאה taken out holds only part תרומה, and only that part counts. This 'לפי חשבון' is exactly the rule our משנה taught.

keyTerms.meaning: The Sages, the majority view opposing a named sage
According to the calculation in it: count only the real share of the original stuff

steps.whatToRemember: רבי אליעזר: a סאה from a mixture counts as full תרומה. חכמים: count only its real share (לפי חשבון). Our משנה follows the חכמים.

phrases.english: And the Sages say:
it does not create a forbidden mixture
except according to the calculation that is in it.

steps.triggerLanguage: וַחֲכָמִים אוֹמְרִים אֵינָהּ מְדַמַּעַת אֶלָּא לְפִי חֶשְׁבּוֹן שֶׁבָּהּ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Completes the quoted משנה by giving the opposing view, which matches our משנה.
steps.raayaObject: That our משנה follows the חכמים, not רבי אליעזר.
steps.raayaSupportSource: The חכמים's ruling in the same משנה in תרומות.

steps.title: Leavened dough also does not follow רבי אליעזר
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes the משנה's case of dough leavened by a mixture. רבי אבא, quoting רבי יוחנן, says this too does not follow רבי אליעזר.
steps.simpleTranslation: 'And dough that was leavened does not leaven,' and so on. רבי אבא said in the name of רבי יוחנן: our משנה is not like רבי אליעזר.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא moves to the next case in the משנה, leavening, and gives the same kind of answer: this too is not רבי אליעזר's view.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Dough leavened with תרומה leaven passes on its status only by the real share of תרומה leaven in it. In the leaven case, רבי אליעזר does not judge the forbidden leaven by its own strength; he goes by whichever leaven fell in last, as the next step shows. So רבי יוחנן says this case also does not follow him.

keyTerms.meaning: Dough that was leavened (here, by תרומה yeast)
Leavens: makes other dough rise and pass on the status
'Etc.' The rest of the quoted line is left out
Our משנה

phrases.english: 'And that which was leavened does not leaven,' etc.
Rabbi Abba said
Rabbi Yochanan said:
Our mishnah is not in accordance with Rabbi Eliezer.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves to the משנה's second case and applies the same identification as step 11.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The leavening case in the משנה also does not follow רבי אליעזר.

steps.title: Two leavens fall into dough: רבי אליעזר follows the last one
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא brings the משנה in ערלה. Plain leaven and תרומה leaven fall into dough, and only together are they strong enough to make it rise. רבי אליעזר says the outcome depends on which one fell in last.
steps.simpleTranslation: As we learned in a משנה: Plain leaven and תרומה leaven fell into dough. Neither one alone was enough to make it rise, but together they made it rise. רבי אליעזר says: I go after the last one that fell in.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא is backing up step 14's claim that our משנה's dough case does not follow רבי אליעזר. It quotes the source where רבי אליעזר gives his opinion.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For רבי אליעזר, the forbidden leaven is not judged by its own strength. If the תרומה leaven fell in last, he treats it as the thing that made the dough rise, so the whole dough becomes forbidden. That does not fit our משנה, which goes by calculation.

keyTerms.meaning: Sourdough starter, the leaven that makes dough rise
Ordinary food that is not holy
Dough
To make the dough rise (become leavened)
They combined, joining together to have an effect
I go after the last one, so whatever fell in last decides the outcome

phrases.english: As we learned in a משנה: leaven of ordinary food
and leaven of תרומה that fell into the dough,
and this one did not have enough to make it rise,
and that one did not have enough to make it rise,
but they combined and made it rise.
רבי אליעזר says:
I go after the last one,
phrases.notes: If the תרומה leaven fell in last, the dough is forbidden to non-כהנים.

steps.triggerLanguage: דִּתְנַן: שְׂאוֹר שֶׁל חוּלִּין וְשֶׁל תְּרוּמָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Supplies the source behind step 14's statement that the dough case is not רבי אליעזר's view.
steps.raayaObject: That our משנה's dough ruling does not follow רבי אליעזר
steps.raayaSupportSource: משנה ערלה, where רבי אליעזר rules by the last item to fall in

steps.title: The חכמים: forbidden leaven counts only if it alone could leaven
steps.stepSummary: The חכמים disagree with רבי אליעזר. It makes no difference whether the forbidden leaven fell first or last. The dough is forbidden only if the forbidden leaven by itself was strong enough to make it rise.
steps.simpleTranslation: And the חכמים say: Whether the forbidden one fell in first or last, it is never forbidden unless it has enough to make the dough rise by itself.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא finishes the quote with the חכמים's view, which matches our משנה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The חכמים judge the forbidden leaven only by its own real strength, not by its timing. This is the same 'by calculation' approach as our משנה. So our משנה follows the חכמים and not רבי אליעזר.

keyTerms.meaning: The forbidden item, here the תרומה leaven
At the start, meaning it fell in first
At the end, meaning it fell in last

steps.whatToRemember: The dough case in our משנה follows the חכמים: forbidden leaven counts only by its own amount. רבי אליעזר, who goes after the last item to fall in, disagrees.

phrases.english: And the חכמים say:
whether the forbidden item fell in first
or the forbidden item fell in last,
the dough is never forbidden
unless the forbidden leaven has enough to make it rise by itself.

steps.triggerLanguage: וַחֲכָמִים אוֹמְרִים: בֵּין שֶׁנָּפַל אִיסּוּר לְכַתְּחִילָּה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Completes the quoted משנה by giving the opposing view, which fits our משנה.
steps.raayaObject: That our משנה's dough ruling matches the חכמים
steps.raayaSupportSource: The חכמים's ruling in משנה ערלה

steps.title: Drawn water and the מקוה: who taught this rule?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes the משנה's next rule: drawn water does not disqualify a מקוה except by calculation. It asks which תנא holds this.
steps.simpleTranslation: The משנה said: 'And drawn water does not disqualify the מקוה' except by calculation. Who is the תנא of this rule?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא moves on to a new rule in the משנה, the one about drawn water in a מקוה. It asks whose opinion this is, which sets up the answer in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Drawn water can disqualify a מקוה. The משנה says it does so only according to its real amount, the same 'by calculation' idea as the earlier cases. The גמרא wants to know which תנא holds this view.

keyTerms.meaning: Drawn water, meaning water carried in a container rather than collected naturally
Ritual bath
Disqualify, making something not valid
Who is the תנא? A question asking whose opinion a teaching follows

phrases.english: 'And drawn water does not'
'disqualify the מקוה.'
Who is the תנא?

steps.triggerLanguage: וְאֵין הַמַּיִם שְׁאוּבִין פּוֹסְלִין אֶת הַמִּקְוֶה. מַאן תָּנָא?
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves on from the dough case to the next clause of the משנה, using the same 'who taught this' pattern as step 10.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Which תנא holds that drawn water disqualifies a מקוה only according to calculation

steps.title: רבי יוחנן: it is רבי אליעזר בן יעקב
steps.stepSummary: רבי חייא בר אבא, quoting רבי יוחנן, says the drawn-water rule follows רבי אליעזר בן יעקב.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי חייא בר אבא said in the name of רבי יוחנן: It is רבי אליעזר בן יעקב.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the question by naming the תנא behind the drawn-water rule.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In the earlier cases, רבי יוחנן only told us who the משנה does NOT follow (רבי אליעזר). Here he names who it DOES follow: רבי אליעזר בן יעקב. Next the גמרא will show his ruling as proof.

keyTerms.meaning: 'It is,' meaning the משנה follows this sage's view

steps.confusionAlert: Do not mix up רבי אליעזר, from the earlier steps, with רבי אליעזר בן יעקב. They are two different תנאים, and here the משנה follows רבי אליעזר בן יעקב.

phrases.english: רבי חייא בר אבא said
that רבי יוחנן said:
It is רבי אליעזר בן יעקב,

steps.title: רבי אליעזר בן יעקב's case: a מקוה with 21 סאה of rainwater
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא starts quoting רבי אליעזר בן יעקב. A מקוה has 21 סאה of rainwater. One carries 19 סאה of drawn water on his shoulder and lets it flow into the מקוה. The quote continues past this point.
steps.simpleTranslation: As we learned: רבי אליעזר בן יעקב says: A מקוה that has 21 סאה of rainwater, one fills 19 סאה by carrying it on the shoulder and lets it flow into the מקוה,
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא begins bringing the source that proves רבי יוחנן's answer. The quote is not finished here and continues in the next part of the text.
steps.deeperAnalysis: A kosher מקוה needs 40 סאה. Here the 21 סאה of rainwater is the majority, and 19 סאה of drawn water is added to make up the rest. Since the drawn water is the smaller part, this sets up the idea that it is judged by its actual amount rather than ruining the whole מקוה.

keyTerms.meaning: A unit of volume. A kosher מקוה needs 40 of them
Rainwater, which is valid for a מקוה

Lets them flow, opening a channel so the water runs in
